subject: Partner gateway exception & operational plan for AtlasCloud ISV connector
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlascloud.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.jensen@atlascust.com, security@atlascust.com
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Hi Monica / Ben —

Thanks for the quick intake last week. We reproduced the issue on our side: AtlasCloud's legacy onboarding flow issues an asymmetric auth redirect (token exchange outside our OAuth flow) for a small subset of enterprise customers. That flow can't be mapped to Redwood's standard marketplace gateway without a short-lived exception (we need a bypass for redirect validation + a constrained IP allowlist).

Ask: Can Redwood provide a timeboxed operational exception (90 days) and a controlled fallback path so we can finish the connector for two pilot customers? If we can't get this, the connector ship slips into Q4 and the customers may pursue alternatives.

Attachments: atlas_saml_flow_v2.pdf (flow diagram), risk_matrix.xlsx (Atlas internal risk assessment)

High level: low user volume initially; requests originate from two enterprise tenants on static IPs; Atlas will accept strict logging + audit hooks and a staged rollback.

Can we get a short call to agree the guardrails and who owns the runbook changes?

—Samir
Head of Integrations, AtlasCloud

---

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlascloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.jensen@atlascust.com
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Samir — thanks for the clear write-up and the artifacts. I want to loop in product + infra early so we can evaluate the operational and security trade-offs.

Ben / Aditya / Karthik — high-level asks from Atlas: timeboxed bypass for redirect validation + IP allowlist. They commit to full audit logs and a rollback trigger. Two immediate pilot accounts.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal triage: scope the code & gateway changes and identify minimal surface area. (Ben + Aditya)
- Security signoff checklist and compensating controls (Karthik)
- Draft runbook and monitoring requirements (I'll own the runbook doc, can start a draft)
- 30-min alignment call today if possible; otherwise tomorrow morning.

Samir — send a couple of slots and we'll pick one.

Monica
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Quick note after a first pass on the diagram: we can implement an IP-based bypass in the gateway with minimal code changes, but we need these constraints enforced at multiple layers (edge + service). Open questions for the call:
- Exactly which endpoints need the bypass? (full redirect validation or only token callback?)
- TTL of the exception and automated rollback trigger conditions
- Audit payloads: what fields Atlas will send so we can correlate events

I've attached a draft integration_runbook_draft.md with suggested monitoring checks and rollback steps. I'll also open SUP-1234 as the engineering ticket.

Attachments: integration_runbook_draft.md

Ben
Principal Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

---

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlascloud.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.jensen@atlascust.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Thanks Ben — attaching the runbook Ben drafted and the risk matrix from Atlas.

Samir / Laura — our preferred guardrails for a 90-day exception:
1) IP allowlist restricted to the two customer CIDRs you provided (static)
2) Exception TTL: 90 days with automatic disable by rule after expiration
3) Full request/response audit forwarded to RedLock (security mailbox) + retention 180 days
4) Daily health check dashboard and alert on anomalous traffic patterns (spike > 3x baseline)
5) Emergency rollback: Redwood can revoke exception immediately; Atlas agrees to notify customers and pause onboarding flows for those tenants for 48 hours while we remediate

Can you confirm Atlas acceptance of the above and provide the CIDRs and the exact callback endpoints? If yes we'll schedule a 30-min handoff to engineering next week and open the SUP ticket to track delivery.

Attachments: risk_matrix.xlsx

Monica

---

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlascloud.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.jensen@atlascust.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Monica / team — confirmed. Atlas accepts the guardrails. CIDRs attached below and callback endpoints are: https://customers.atlascloud.com/oauth/callback and https://customers.atlascloud.com/auth/redirect

We also agree to add an HMAC header for request provenance. We'll get the formal acceptance note signed later today.

Attached: atlas_saml_flow_v2.pdf, risk_matrix.xlsx

—Samir

---

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, samir.patel@atlascloud.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

Following up from my review: engineering can complete the minimal gateway change and the automation for TTL/rollbacks within two sprints (3 weeks). Conditions:
- Atlas provides precise CIDRs and will route test traffic to our staging cluster for validation
- Security to verify the HMAC header scheme and RedLock log ingestion
- We'll add a dedicated feature flag and a metric to track bypassed requests

I'll create the SUP and add the acceptance checklist. Tentative delivery target: 2028-07-01.

Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, samir.patel@atlascloud.com, laura.jensen@atlascust.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary gateway exception for AtlasCloud ISV connector

All — thanks for the quick alignment. Action items we agreed on:
- Atlas: provide CIDRs + HMAC scheme + staging test plan (Samir, by Mon 6/12)
- Security (Karthik): review HMAC scheme and confirm RedLock ingestion (by Tue 6/13)
- Eng (Aditya): open SUP-1234, implement feature flag & TTL automation, stage rollout (target 7/1)
- Product (Ben): finalize runbook and QA checklist (by 6/15)
- Ops (Monica): publish runbook to shared drive and schedule the engineering handoff call (6/14)

I'll mark SUP-1234 as the canonical tracker and share the drive link once the doc is in place. Appreciate the responsiveness — we should be able to keep to the 90-day exception plan with the safeguards listed.

Monica
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
